decision: Verified sufficient moments for a labeled fixed-weight WR approximation, not the full official design variance
official_design: Single-stage stratified cluster simple random sampling without replacement; full selected areas surveyed.
approximation: Source uses final expansion weights as fixed and omits FPC. Final nonresponse adjustment does not establish calibration weights; no natural selection weights or stratum population PSU totals reconstructed.
limitations: Only person-file observed PSUs included; wholly nonresponding sampled PSUs unknown.
Selected-extremum SE is not simultaneous confidence coverage.
Completed schooling remains a current-stage assumption.
No PSU/person IDs or dates are published by this audit.
